objective: Deliver the supplied reminder once to my voicemail, or once to me if I answer.
context: This is an authorized test call to my own number. Wait for the voicemail greeting and beep. Do not repeat the message.
success_criteria: The entire reminder is spoken once after the greeting
The call ends after the message

acceptable_alternatives: Deliver the reminder once to a person who answers
information_may_disclose: The supplied reminder and that this is an automated recorded call

voicemail.message: This is your automated assistant with a recorded test reminder: remember to take out the recycling tomorrow morning. The cardboard boxes have formed a committee, and they are demanding a change of scenery.
